name: Bread Incremental 🍞
desc:
🍞 Collect slices of bread, sell bread to make money, upgrade to earn more money, gain different flavors of sliced bread, and prestige to unlock secrets!

✏️ Any suggestions or bugs/issues you have, please say them in the group wall or group community server!

🍞 Group members get an auto-collect feature and get +20% money. Premium players get +20% money too.

🍉 Heavily inspired by Fruit Incremental!
🎨 Art made by @katelynrocks02/@cauthernarts!
⚒️ Made by Toomoo's Games!
